title: reseda urnigera var. boissieri
intro: Reseda urnigera var. boissieri, commonly known as var. boissieri or Boissier's Reseda, is a plant species in the family Resedaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Reseda urnigera var. boissieri include antiseptic, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, making it useful for treating coughs, colds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
